# vmo2wav

**Home page:** [http://chaos.allsiemens.com/software.html](https://web.archive.org/web/20130813164842/http://chaos.allsiemens.com/software.html) (web archive)<br/>
**Author:** Chaos

A converter program for voice recorder files (VMO) to WAV format. Runs
from the command line (MS-DOS prompt, FAR, Windows Commander).

By default, the program normalizes (levels) the signal level. This feature
can be disabled by running vmo2wav with the `-n` parameter.
